__resources.name: 👤 Staff Auth
__resources.description: Register, login, refresh, logout, /me for staff/owners

__resources.name: Health Check
__resources.description: Verify the service is running. Expected: { success: true, data: { service, status, uptime } }

__resources.name: Register (new owner)
__resources.description:
Creates a new staff/owner account.
Returns JWT with tenant_id: null and role: pending_onboarding.
Copy the access_token and refresh_token into the environment variables.

__resources.name: Login
__resources.description:
Login for staff/owners.
No tenant_id needed while still pending_onboarding.
Once onboarded, add "tenant_id": "<id>" to the body.
Copy access_token → env.access_token, refresh_token → env.refresh_token.

__resources.name: Get Current User (/me)
__resources.description:
Returns the currently authenticated user.
Requires Bearer token in Authorization header.
Set env.access_token from Register or Login response first.

__resources.name: Refresh Token
__resources.description:
Exchange a refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair.
Set env.refresh_token from Register or Login response first.
Update env.access_token and env.refresh_token with the new values.

__resources.name: Logout
__resources.description:
Blacklists the current access token in Redis.
After this, /me with the same token will return 401.

__resources.name: Send OTP
__resources.description:
Sends an OTP to the given phone number.
In dev (no MSG91 keys), the OTP is logged to the service console — check your terminal.
Note: the field is 'phone', not 'mobile'.

__resources.name: Verify OTP
__resources.description:
Verifies the OTP. Auto-registers the customer if first time.
Replace '123456' with the OTP from the service console logs.
Returns a customer JWT — copy it to env.customer_access_token.

__resources.name: Get Customer Profile
__resources.description:
Fetch the authenticated customer's profile.
Uses the customer JWT (different from staff JWT).
Set env.customer_access_token from Verify OTP response.

__resources.name: Update Customer Profile
__resources.description: Update the customer's name and/or email.

__resources.name: Assign Tenant to User (internal)
__resources.description:
Called by tenant-service after creating a tenant.
NOT exposed through Kong — internal service-to-service only.
X-Internal-Secret header is required.
Replace <user_id> in the URL and <tenant_id> in the body with real values.
This promotes the user from pending_onboarding → tenant_owner.
